landing.heroDesc: Work with Telegram, Facebook, VK, MAX and WhatsApp in one workspace. Find relevant conversations, collect incoming requests and organize leads for follow-up. Choose your platform, connect your accounts and use the tools available for each channel.
landing.howTitle: How 24GO works — 3 steps to qualified leads
landing.howFullDesc: A Telegram workflow example: configure accounts and groups, review classified leads and choose permitted follow-up actions. VK has different controls; mass direct messaging is unavailable.
landing.step1Desc: Configure accounts, proxies and activity limits. Limits do not guarantee protection from platform restrictions.
landing.step1Point1: Add Telegram accounts via phone number — verification codes sent automatically
landing.step1Point2: VK connection requirements depend on the selected tool; a community token is not a discovery credential.
landing.step1Point3: Assign dedicated SOCKS5 proxies — 1 proxy per account for safety
landing.step1Point4: Review account status and limits before enabling automation
landing.step1Point5: Set daily quotas and anti-spam limits per account
landing.step2Desc: Add permitted target groups and enable the monitoring supported by the selected platform. Available messages can be classified as leads; access, schedules and provider restrictions affect coverage.
landing.step2Point1: Monitor public Telegram groups and VK communities simultaneously
landing.step2Point2: Scan by GEO, niche, and keywords to find relevant groups
landing.step2Point3: HOT/WARM/COLD classification with customizable scoring rules
landing.step2Point4: Configure Telegram reply rules; VK mass direct messaging is unavailable
landing.step3Desc: Qualified leads appear in your Kanban pipeline. Export to CRM, push to webhooks, or auto-reply — your choice.

landing.step3Point2: CSV export or real-time webhook delivery to your CRM
landing.step3Point3: Telegram reply templates and rules, subject to account access and platform limits
landing.step3Point4: Full analytics: conversion rates, source tracking, team leaderboard

landing.faq1A: 24GO is an AI-powered lead generation platform for Telegram and VK. It automatically scans groups and communities, classifies messages by purchase intent (HOT/WARM/COLD), and helps you convert leads into paying clients.
landing.faq2A: Configure an account and permitted groups, then enable the platform's monitoring workflow. Available incoming messages are classified using the configured rules or AI path. Stored configuration, scheduled processing and verified receipt are different states; access and coverage depend on the provider.
landing.faq3Q: Do I need to provide my own Telegram/VK accounts?
landing.faq3A: Connection requirements differ by platform and tool. Use the relevant account connection form; never share passwords or tokens in chat. Live provider access must be checked separately.
landing.faq4A: Account settings include proxies and activity limits. These controls do not guarantee delivery or prevent restrictions; follow platform rules and monitor account status.
landing.faq5A: 24GO integrates with AmoCRM, HubSpot, Bitrix24, Google Sheets via webhooks and direct API. You can also export leads as CSV or use the REST API for custom integrations.
landing.faq6A: 24GO starts at $25/month for the Starter plan. There's a free 3-day trial with no credit card required. We also offer Pro ($75/mo) and Enterprise ($300/mo) plans with higher limits and priority support.

landing.t1Text: Connected 15 accounts, getting 300+ qualified leads monthly. The AI classification saves hours of manual filtering. ROI paid for itself in the first week.
landing.t2Text: The HOT/WARM/COLD classification is incredibly accurate. We focus only on high-intent leads now. Response time dropped from hours to 30 seconds.
landing.t3Text: Closed $120K in deals within the first 3 months. The auto-reply feature catches leads while we sleep. Best investment in our sales pipeline.
landing.t4Text: Auto-replies work flawlessly. HOT leads get instant responses, WARM leads get nurturing sequences. Our conversion rate doubled in 6 weeks.
landing.t5Text: Managing 30+ accounts from one dashboard is a game changer. Proxy management, warm-up, quotas — everything automated. Pure efficiency.
landing.t6Text: Team collaboration features are solid. Multiple users can manage accounts, review leads, and track campaigns. The audit log keeps everyone accountable.
landing.t7Text: Group discovery found us 50+ relevant communities we never knew existed. The TGStat integration with AI query expansion is brilliant.
landing.t8Text: Lead qualification rules let me customize scoring for my niche. Real estate keywords trigger HOT classification automatically. Saves 3 hours daily.
landing.t9Text: Webhook integration pushes leads directly into our CRM. No manual data entry, no lost leads. The n8n integration is seamless.
landing.t10Text: Proxy management is top notch. Bulk import, auto-assignment, health monitoring. Each account gets a dedicated proxy — no bans in 4 months.
landing.t11Text: API access lets us integrate 24GO into our custom workflows. Campaign scheduling with spintax and cron is powerful. True automation.
landing.t12Text: Campaign analytics show exactly which groups and messages convert. A/B testing headlines doubled our click-through rate. Data-driven decisions.
landing.t13Text: Speed to lead is everything. 24GO responds to HOT prospects in under 30 seconds. We're closing deals competitors don't even know about yet.
landing.t14Text: Scaled from 5 to 40 accounts seamlessly. The platform handles warm-up, quotas, and anti-spam automatically. Growth without the headaches.
landing.t15Text: Onboarding was smooth. Connected accounts, set up rules, and started getting leads within 48 hours. The demo data loader helped us test everything first.
landing.t16Text: B2B-specific features are exactly what we needed. Lead rules with industry presets, keyword scoring, and GEO targeting — built for our use case.
